description: Label normalization mapping for FakeNewsNet (Shu et al., 2019)

real.rationale: Article confirmed as factual by PolitiFact/GossipCop journalists.

fake.rationale: Article confirmed as fabricated or debunked by PolitiFact/GossipCop.

notes: FakeNewsNet is fundamentally binary; MISLEADING and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE are not present in raw dataset ground truth.
